About the position

Stefanini Group is hiring! Exciting opportunity awaits, let us help you get started! Click Apply now or you may call Ghanshyam Sharma at +1 (248) 263-5646 or email at Ghanshyam.Sharma@stefanini.com for faster processing! Interview: Virtual Meetings 1 hour Location: Hybrid 1 day in office - (Open to relocation at the resource expense) Overview: We are looking for a Junior Web Developer with an interest in Digital Accessibility to help build and maintain accessible web applications. In this role, you will work with developers and designers to ensure websites and applications meet WCAG and ADA accessibility standards, creating inclusive digital experiences for all users.

Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain accessible web applications
• Ensure websites comply with WCAG and ADA accessibility guidelines
• Perform accessibility testing and resolve usability issues
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
• Participate in code reviews and team collaboration

Requirements
• Associate degree or coursework in Computer Science or related field
• Knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming concepts
• Experience with at least one programming language such as Java, Python, C#, or C++ (2 years)
• Basic understanding of SQL and databases
• Familiarity with Windows or Linux environments
• Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Nice-to-haves
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
• Understanding of WCAG, ARIA, or Section 508 accessibility standards
• Experience with .NET or Java-based applications
• Familiarity with accessibility testing tools such as Level Access
